description: Reads a website's robots.txt and reports which of 15 AI crawlers (from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Apple, Meta and others) may crawl its homepage, separating bots that fetch pages for AI answers from bots that collect training data, plus the robots.txt lines that would let blocked answer bots in.

website.description: The product's website, like acme.com (a full URL works too).

name: check_ai_crawlers
title: Check AI crawler access
